newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to continue strict fiscal policy - Montoro.
newsitem.headline: Spain to continue strict fiscal policy - Montoro.

text.p: The Spanish government will continue to follow its restrictive fiscal and anti-inflation policy in the hope of further reductions in interest rates, Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Wednesday.
Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato meanwhile said that Spain intends to go ahead with its liberalisation of key sectors.
Both were speaking at an inauguration function at the Economy Ministry.
"In the coming months we will persist in the liberalisation of key sectors," Rato said.
He was referring to coming reforms in telecomunications, energy and property.
Rato added that Spanish economy is in one of its best stability periods ever, even though he said that in the coming months further efforts were needed to consolidate the recovery.
